name: Ruins of Southshore
summary: In the current era of Year 25 ADP, the town of Southshore stands fully intact as the Alliance's primary coastal port and stronghold in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Travelers seeking ruins will find no devastated city here today, though constant threats from the Forsaken and lurking shoreline monsters keep the settlement under ceaseless siege.

sections.title: A Bulwark Still Standing
sections.body: Southshore is far from a ruin in this age. As one of the few remaining bastions of the fallen Kingdom of Lordaeron, it serves as an indispensable port and haven for the Alliance in the northern subcontinent. Positioned directly between the encroaching Forsaken forces from Tarren Mill and the encroaching horrors of the coastline, Southshore's garrisons remain vigilant against any assault seeking to reduce their home to ash.

sections.title: Threats on the Eastern Strand
sections.body: While rumors and fears of total devastation linger among scouts, the real immediate peril stems from the sea. Along the Eastern Strand just outside the town, hostile Daggerspine naga have gathered in force. Alliance patrols frequently discover scouting parties and attack orders suggesting these serpent-kin covet Southshore's docks and waterways, hoping to seize the town whenever the defenders falter.

faq.answer: No. In Year 25 ADP, Southshore is a bustling, fully functional human port town and the Alliance's central outpost in the Hillsbrad Foothills. It has not fallen into ruin, despite relentless conflict with the Forsaken and local threats.

faq.q: What is the danger on the beaches near Southshore?
faq.answer: Hostile Daggerspine naga have colonized the Eastern Strand east of the town docks. These naga continually probe Southshore's defenses and plot incursions against the harbor, posing a constant danger to local fishermen and patrols.

Southshore is firmly under Alliance control. It remains one of the last major human settlements in Lordaeron, defended by human guards and allied troops acting as a base against the Horde and the Scourge.

faq.q: Why is Southshore so critical to the Alliance?
faq.answer: With Lordaeron shattered by the plague and the Scourge, Southshore provides the Alliance with a vital deep-water harbor and land base in the north, allowing troops and supplies to travel directly into the Hillsbrad Foothills.

angles.text: Southshore stands as your vital lifeline in the northern kingdoms; protecting its docks and defending its borders against the Forsaken is crucial to maintaining a foothold in Lordaeron.
Southshore represents the last major bastion of human power in Hillsbrad, acting as an obstinate barrier to securing total control over the region.
